sentence: How's it going, man? Haven't seen you in a minute.
meaning: 最中性嘅美式打招呼，等於「點呀／近排點」；問嘅人多數唔係真想聽你講詳情。

sentence: What's up? You look like you just saw a ghost.
meaning: 打招呼多過真問你喺做咩；語氣好 casual，等於「喂，點呀」。

sentence: Morning. Coffee's in the back, help yourself.
meaning: 美國辦公室、電梯、走廊嘅極短招呼，等於「早晨」，唔使加 Good。

sentence: How you been? Last I heard you moved out to Denver.
meaning: 久無見嘅問候，關心你最近過成點；美式口語會省咗 have。

sentence: Long time no see. You still working at the shop?
meaning: 好久不見；已經係美式固定講法，唔當中文直譯嘅錯英文。

sentence: You good? You've been staring at that screen for an hour.
meaning: 問你仲得唔得、有冇事；美式關心，唔等於撩交嗌。

sentence: How's the family? Your mom still doing the garden thing?
meaning: 美式街坊／同事 small talk 嘅標準題，關心你屋企人，但唔會追問。

sentence: Some weather, huh? My basement's already wet.
meaning: 天氣做開場白嘅美式講法，句尾 huh 係等人附和。

sentence: For here or to go? — To go, please.
meaning: 快餐店、咖啡店必問：堂食定外賣。美式用 to go，唔用 takeaway。
tags: 餐廳/咖啡廳/服務員/日常

sentence: Need a bag? — Nah, I'm good, thanks.
meaning: 超商、雜貨店收銀問你要唔要袋；美式口語省咗 Do you。

sentence: Can I get the check when you get a sec?
meaning: 埋單。美式餐廳講 check，唔講 bill。

sentence: I'll have the same, but no onions.
meaning: 同對方叫一樣嘅；美式落單標準講法，唔用 I want。

sentence: You're all set. Your table's right this way.
meaning: 搞掂晒、你可以走／可以用喇；服務業收尾萬用語。

sentence: Sorry, coming through — hot pan, hot pan.
meaning: 借借、唔該借過；美式人多地方用，語氣輕但直接。

sentence: Where's the restroom? — Back left, past the counter.
meaning: 廁所喺邊；美式一定用 restroom／bathroom，唔用 toilet。

sentence: Am I going the right way for the train station?
phrase: Am I going the right way?
meaning: 行錯路未啊？美式問路最自然嘅問法。

sentence: Hang a left at the light, then it's the second driveway.
meaning: 轉左。美式口語 hang a left，比 turn left 更日常。

sentence: It's right around the corner from the gas station.
meaning: 就喺附近、轉個彎就到；美式最常用嘅「近」講法。

sentence: Sorry, my bad — I grabbed the wrong folder.
meaning: 認錯、我唔啱；美式口語道歉，語氣輕，唔算正式道歉。

sentence: I appreciate it. Seriously, you didn't have to.
meaning: 唔該晒、多謝；美式比 thank you 更真誠、更有重量嘅道謝。

sentence: No worries, it happens to everybody.
meaning: 唔緊要、唔使客氣；輕鬆版本嘅 you're welcome。

sentence: Right? That's exactly what I told him.
meaning: 句尾求附和：係咪呀、你都覺呢；用嚟拉對方入自己陣營。

sentence: I'm good, thanks — I already ate.
meaning: 唔使喇、我夠喇；美式婉拒嘅第一選擇，比 no thank you 自然。

sentence: I'm gonna pass on the karaoke, but thanks for asking.
meaning: 我唔去／我唔要；比 no 禮貌，但意思好清楚。

sentence: Maybe next time — this week's kinda crazy.
meaning: 下次啦；美式軟拒絕，通常等於「今次唔會」。

sentence: It's fine, really. I just need a minute.
meaning: 真係冇事；但語氣一沉就係「其實有事，我唔想講」。

sentence: Sounds good. So I'll text you when I'm outside.
meaning: 好呀、就咁話；美式最常用嘅同意，唔使講 yes。

sentence: You bet — I'll get that out today.
meaning: 當然啦／冇問題；中西部味重嘅美式答應。

sentence: For sure, man. Anytime.
meaning: 一定啦／係呀；美式加強同意，語氣比 sure 熱。

sentence: Yeah, no, that's not gonna work for me.
meaning: 唔係咁／唔好啦；先 yeah 後 no 係美式獨有嘅緩衝，唔係口誤。

sentence: I hear you, but the deadline's not moving.
meaning: 我明白你講咩；但唔等於我同意，係美式最常用嘅緩衝。

sentence: That sucks. Did they at least give you a refund?
meaning: 好慘、好煩（唔帶粗口嘅同情）；美式安慰，語氣好直接。

sentence: Hang in there — the semester's almost over.
meaning: 頂住、撐落去；美式打氣，用喺對方捱緊嘅時候。

sentence: You got this. Just breathe and start talking.
meaning: 你得嘅、搞得掂；近年美式最流行嘅打氣。

sentence: Take your time. We're not in a rush.
meaning: 你慢慢嚟、唔急；美式禮貌，反面係催。

sentence: Let me know if you need a ride, okay?
meaning: 有消息話我知；美式收尾萬用句，唔等於命令。

sentence: Anyway, I should probably head out.
meaning: 講返正題／算啦；用嚟截断話題或者收線嘅美式 filler。

sentence: I gotta run — my parking meter's about to expire.
meaning: 我要走喇；美式口語 gotta＝got to，係最自然嘅道別開場。

sentence: See you around. Say hi to your mom for me.
meaning: 遲啲見；唔一定真係約實，係美式隨口道別。

sentence: Take it easy, man. Don't let them get to you.
meaning: 保重／慢慢嚟；美式道別，亦可以叫對方冷靜。

sentence: Have a good one. Drive safe.
meaning: 祝你今日順利；美式店員、同事最常用嘅收尾。

sentence: Let's grab coffee sometime — I want to hear how the move went.
meaning: 不如搵日飲杯咖啡；美式社交邀約，可以係真心亦可以係客套。

sentence: Because I said so. Now get in the car.
meaning: 因為我話事；美式父母終極句，唔會再解釋。

sentence: Don't wait up — I'll be at the shop till late.
meaning: 唔好等我返嚟先瞓；美式家庭／情侶夜歸交代。

sentence: I mean, y'know, that's not what I said.
meaning: 我意思係……；用嚟修正、軟化或者鋪墊，係美式最密嘅 filler。

sentence: He's got zero rizz, and somehow that's his whole personality.
meaning: 撩人嘅魅力、口才；Gen Z 講嘅 charm，多數帶戲謔。
tags: 潮語/戀愛/年輕人/網絡用語

sentence: No cap, that's the best burger in the city.
meaning: 講真、冇吹水；用嚟強調自己句句真。

sentence: Bet. I'll be outside in five.
meaning: 好、冇問題；Gen Z 嘅「就咁話」，比 okay 更爽快。

sentence: It's giving 'I've never worked retail in my life.'
meaning: 呢個感覺好……；形容某人／某物散發嘅氣質，後面一定接名詞。

sentence: Lowkey, I've been avoiding that phone call all week.
meaning: 有啲、暗暗地；用嚟減弱語氣，等於「其實有少少」。

sentence: The pizza was mid, honestly. Like, I don't get the hype.
meaning: 好普通、唔值一提；比 bad 更刻薄嘅貶。

sentence: This playlist slaps, though — who made it?
meaning: 好正、好聽；多數用嚟講歌。

sentence: It's not that deep — it's just a group chat.
meaning: 唔使咁認真、冇咁嚴重；用嚟潑冷水或降溫。

sentence: You're being delulu if you think he's gonna text back.
meaning: 自欺欺人、諗多咗；delusional 嘅 Gen Z 縮寫。

sentence: He said 'hubby' on the first date and I got the ick.
meaning: 突然反感、被煞到；本來有好感，一下覺得嘔心。

sentence: I can't even — she wore white to the wedding.
meaning: 我真係頂唔順；Millennial 式誇張無語，通常配一個笑。

sentence: Literally, I died when he said that.
meaning: 真係、離譜到係咁；Millennial 用嚟加強，多數唔係字面意思。

sentence: The client moved the deadline twice. This is fine.
meaning: 冇事、冇事（其實火災）；出自 meme，用嚟自嘲頂唔住。

sentence: Oof. That's gonna leave a mark.
meaning: 唉／慘；聽到壞消息嘅即時反應，一個字夠。

sentence: He ghosted me after three dates, then liked my post.
meaning: 被人突然失聯；約會／朋友／客戶人間蒸發，冇交代。

sentence: He posted the worst take of the year and got ratio'd in ten minutes.
meaning: 被人喺留言區壓過；X／Twitter 上 reply 讚數遠高過原帖，等於被公開打臉。

sentence: Show the receipts or stop talking.
meaning: 證據、截圖；網上講「我有 proof」嘅意思。

sentence: Go touch grass, man. You've been posting all day.
meaning: 出去行下、離開網絡；叫人唔好再喺網上發癲。

sentence: It's so over — the client saw the draft.
meaning: 完咗、冇得救；網上 mood 用語，通常同 We're so back 成對。

sentence: Not me crying at a dog food commercial.
meaning: 唔係我呀（其實就係我）；用嚟自嘲自己做咗件瘀事。

sentence: Are you serious right now? You cancelled on my mom?
meaning: 你而家係咪講真；美式衝突升溫第一句，唔帶粗口但火氣足。

sentence: Excuse me? Say that again, slower.
meaning: 你講咩話？；美式最常見嘅被冒犯反應，升調，等於「你再講一次試下」。

sentence: You wanna go? 'Cause I've got all night.
meaning: 想打架呀？；美式街頭挑釁，唔使粗口都好有火。

sentence: Don't play with me. I know what you did.
meaning: 唔好同我玩嘢；美式警告，意思係「你玩唔起」。

sentence: Say it to my face, not in the group chat.
meaning: 當面講；美式衝突經典句，針對背後講壞話。

sentence: That's a you problem, not a me problem.
meaning: 呢個係你自己嘅問題；美式極冷淡嘅推卸，等於「關我咩事」。

sentence: Watch your mouth. That's my sister you're talking about.
meaning: 小心你把口；美式警告，通常喺對方講咗侮辱說話之後。

sentence: I'm finna head out — you need anything?
meaning: 就快、準備去；I'm going to 嘅 AAVE 縮寫。

sentence: Deadass, I saw him at the deli this morning.
meaning: 講真、冇講笑；紐約起家嘅強調語。

sentence: On God, that's exactly what happened.
meaning: 我發誓、真嘅；美式街頭／年輕世代強調句。

sentence: Ain't no way you paid forty bucks for that.
meaning: 唔係啩、冇可能；美式雙重否定式嘅難以置信。

sentence: That's the best burger in town, period.
meaning: 句號、就咁話；用嚟封頂，等於「唔使再討論」。

sentence: I'm on line at the deli and it's not moving.
meaning: 排隊；紐約市講法，同英式 queue 相對。

sentence: That's hella expensive for a burrito.
meaning: 好、非常；加州（灣區）加強詞。

sentence: That clam chowder's wicked good.
meaning: 好、非常；新英格蘭（尤其波士頓）加強詞。

sentence: Y'all coming or what?
meaning: 你哋；南方（同 AAVE）第二人稱複數，今日全美年輕人都在用。

sentence: Ope, sorry, didn't mean to stop in your way.
meaning: 哎呀（唔好意思）；中西部人撞到人／要擠過去嘅反射聲。

sentence: What the fuck? Who moved my tools?
meaning: 搞咩呀；美式最直接嘅震驚／不滿，p3 級粗口。

sentence: Holy shit, you actually did it.
meaning: 嘩屌；美式驚嘆，可以係好可以係壞，語氣重。

sentence: Are you shitting me? They raised the rent again?
meaning: 你耍我呀；美式粗口版嘅難以置信，比 are you kidding me 重好多。

sentence: What the hell is that noise?
meaning: 搞咩呀；比 what the fuck 輕好多，仲可以出街。

sentence: Damn it, I left the keys in the truck.
meaning: 頂；美式輕度發洩，唔算攻擊人。

sentence: Screw that — I'm not working another weekend.
meaning: 算啦、唔做；美式帶火嘅拒絕，屬輕度粗口替代。

sentence: Let's circle back on the budget after the client call.
meaning: 我哋遲啲再傾返呢個；corporate-speak 用嚟拖，或者唔想而家決定。

sentence: Let's touch base Thursday and see where the numbers land.
meaning: 我哋聯絡下／對一對進度；美式商務最常見嘅開會邀約語。

sentence: Do you have the bandwidth to take this one? It's due Friday.
meaning: 你有冇時間／精力接呢件事；bandwidth 講人，唔係網絡。

sentence: Let's take this offline — I don't want to get into numbers here.
meaning: 我哋私下再傾；會議上截停一個唔適合公開講嘅話題。

sentence: I'll loop you in on the thread so you have the context.
meaning: 我拉你入嚟（email／對話）；美式職場接納同事參與。

sentence: Low-hanging fruit first — we can save the hard stuff for Q3.
meaning: 最容易見效嘅部分；企業用嚟講先做容易嘅事。

sentence: What's the ask here? Am I writing it or just reviewing?
meaning: 你想我做咩／你需要咩；美式商務直接問要求。

sentence: Ping me when you land and I'll send the address.
meaning: 有咩就打我／傳訊息我；美式職場講 ping，唔講 contact。

sentence: Per my last email, the deadline was Friday, not Monday.
meaning: 正如我上一封 email 講過；美式職場最含蓄嘅發火。

sentence: Just following up on the estimate I sent last week.
meaning: 跟進一下；美式 email 開場，實際係催你回覆。

sentence: Let's put a pin in the hiring question and finish the deck.
phrase: Let's put a pin in it.
meaning: 呢個先擺住，遲啲再講；美式開會用嚟封存話題。

sentence: Let's get our ducks in a row before we present to the board.
phrase: Let's get our ducks in a row.
meaning: 先將嘢排好、準備妥當；美式 idiom，帶少少老派。

sentence: At the end of the day, it's your call, not mine.
phrase: At the end of the day,
meaning: 講到底、最終；美式總結句開頭，經常用嚟收一個爭論。

sentence: I need it by EOD — the client's presenting in the morning.
meaning: 今日收工前要；美式職場 EOD＝end of day，比 tomorrow 更硬。

sentence: Get it done. I don't care how — just make sure it's right.
meaning: 搞掂佢；美式上司式命令，唔想聽解釋。

sentence: That's not what I asked for. I said a one-pager, not twenty slides.
phrase: That's not what I asked for.
meaning: 我要嘅唔係呢個；美式上司／客戶最直接嘅不滿，唔帶粗口但好硬。

sentence: Walk me through it — how did we get from forty to ninety?
meaning: 由頭講一次畀我聽；美式上司／面試官最常用嘅「你解釋下」。

sentence: I'm on it. Give me till noon.
meaning: 我即刻做；美式下屬最常用嘅接單回應，比 yes sir 自然。

sentence: Tell me about yourself — and keep it under two minutes.
meaning: 介紹下你自己；美式面試第一句，實際係要你講一個 90 秒故事。

sentence: Where do you see yourself in five years — honestly?
phrase: Where do you see yourself in five years?
meaning: 五年後你想點；美式面試經典題，測你有冇計劃。

sentence: What's your biggest weakness? — And don't say perfectionism.
meaning: 你最大缺點係咩；美式面試陷阱題，標準答案是包裝過的優點。

sentence: Do you have any questions for us? — Yeah, what does success look like in month one?
phrase: Do you have any questions for us?
meaning: 你有咩想問我哋；美式面試收尾，答冇等於唔感興趣。

sentence: We'll be in touch. Thanks for coming in.
meaning: 我哋會聯絡你；美式面試／提案收尾，通常等於「唔使等」。

sentence: Thanks for coming in. Somebody will reach out by Friday.
meaning: 多謝你嚟；美式面試收尾，語氣中性，唔代表 result。

sentence: I'm not sure this is the right fit — for either of us.
phrase: I'm not sure this is the right fit.
meaning: 我覺得唔係好啱；美式最禮貌嘅拒絕 offer／提案講法。

sentence: Can you give me an estimate before I decide? No pressure.
phrase: Can you give me an estimate?
meaning: 可唔可以報個價；美式裝修／工程第一步，叫 estimate（通常免費）。

sentence: Do we need a permit for this, or can we just frame it out?
phrase: Do we need a permit for this?
meaning: 呢樣要唔要申請許可；美式裝修必問，冇 permit 會被停工罰款。

sentence: That's a change order — you want the outlet moved after drywall.
meaning: 呢個要開變更單；美式裝修加錢加時嘅正式機制，唔係師傅獅子開大口。

sentence: What's on the punch list? I saw a gap by the baseboard.
meaning: 仲有咩收尾未搞；美式工程完工前嘅清單，一項項捉漏。

sentence: It's not up to code — that railing's gotta be forty-two inches.
meaning: 唔符合建築規例；美式師傅最有力嘅一句，等於「一定要改」。

sentence: That's a load-bearing wall. We're not touching it without an engineer.
meaning: 嗰幅係主力牆；美式裝修最常聽到嘅「唔可以拆」。

sentence: Half up front, half when we're done — that's how I work.
phrase: Half up front, half when we're done.
meaning: 一半訂金，完工找尾數；美式小型工程最常見嘅付款方式。

sentence: I'll have my guy take a look at the wiring on Thursday.
phrase: I'll have my guy take a look.
meaning: 我叫個師傅去睇下；美式承辦商口吻，唔會自己出手。

sentence: Can I put you on hold for about two minutes?
phrase: Can I put you on hold?
meaning: 可唔可以等我一下；美式客服標準句，唔講 wait a moment。

sentence: I understand your frustration, and I want to fix it.
meaning: 我明白你唔滿意；美式客服必備安撫句，但唔等於認錯。

sentence: Let me look into that and call you back before five.
meaning: 我幫你查下；美式客服最常用嘅拖延式承諾。

sentence: I'd like to speak to a manager, please. This is the third time.
phrase: I'd like to speak to a manager.
meaning: 我要同你上司講；美式投訴升級嘅標準句，講完通常即場有讓步。

sentence: I want a refund. The part doesn't even fit.
meaning: 我要退錢；美式消費者最直接嘅要求，唔使講到好婉轉。

sentence: That's not what we agreed on. The number was eight, not ten.
phrase: That's not what we agreed on.
meaning: 我哋講好咗唔係咁；美式談判／找數爭執嘅關鍵句。

sentence: We're running behind schedule — the tile's back-ordered two weeks.
meaning: 我哋落後咗進度；美式工程／專案最常用嘅壞消息講法。

sentence: That's my final offer — twelve five, and I'll throw in the haul-away.
meaning: 呢個係我最後價；美式談判封頂句，但通常仍然可以再傾。

sentence: Let's meet in the middle — nine thousand, cash.
meaning: 大家各讓一步；美式講價最常用嘅折衷句。

sentence: We're way over budget — the plumbing alone ate twenty grand.
meaning: 我哋超支好多；美式專案／裝修最常見嘅爆數。

sentence: Money doesn't grow on trees — you want it, you work for it.
meaning: 錢唔係樹上面摘落嚟；美式父母／老闆最愛嘅省錢箴言。

sentence: Quid pro quo — I get the intro, you get the footage.
meaning: 互換條件、你幫我我幫你；美式商務／法律用嘅拉丁片語，帶交易味。
